title: Ron Tototz and Parr, Nha Trang
description: A close, laughing snapshot from the first weeks in-country: Ron Tototz (left) — from Des Moines, Iowa, Larry says — and Parr (right), who held the same rank as Larry, probably PFC, and was at Nha Trang with him after they landed. Larry dates it September or October 1964, during the roughly two months when "they didn't know where to put us."
researchNotes: Larry's own account (Memories comments, 2026-08-15; archived as data/recollections/giscus-vn-0025-c18032311.json, -c18032317.json, and -c18032339.json). Corrects the survey's guess that the fair-haired man might be Larry — it is Parr. Two research gains: Ron's hometown (Des Moines, Iowa), which with the stories comment of the same day led to his identification from documents on 2026-08-16 (ledger #15; data/people/ron-tototz.json); and his account of the first two months at Nha Trang, which agrees with the timeline entry (itself built on his testimony), with the added color that the new arrivals had no assignment yet.
